description: This file defines the interface for a Windows-specific Keymaster communication channel that uses named pipes for IPC/RPC calls. It declares the KeymasterWindowsChannel class, its methods, and associated members, including handling of asynchronous pipe operations.

classes.name: KeymasterWindowsChannel
classes.description: A class implementing a communication channel over Windows named pipes for Keymaster IPC/RPC calls, supporting synchronous message sending and receiving.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Static factory method to create an instance of KeymasterWindowsChannel with a given pipe handle.

methods.name: SendRequest
methods.description: Sends a request message with a specified command and message payload.

methods.name: SendResponse
methods.description: Sends a response message with a specified command and message payload.

methods.name: ReceiveMessage
methods.description: Receives a message from the pipe, returning a ManagedKeymasterMessage.

methods.name: WaitForConnection
methods.description: Waits for a connection on the specified pipe handle.

methods.name: SendMessage
methods.description: Sends a message over the pipe with specified command and response flag.

methods.name: ReadFromPipe
methods.description: Reads data from the pipe into a buffer.
